name: AI Tool List

sources.title: Homepage — small live static AI tools list (GitHub-backed, categories: Chat & Text, Image & Art, Audio & Speech, Productivity, Writing, Finance)
Submit a Tool — fork github.com/aitoollist/awesome-ai-tool-list, add tool to README.md, open a PR

requirements: GitHub workflow: fork the awesome-ai-tool-list repo, add the tool to the right category in README.md, open a pull request
Listings show name, description, tags, pricing, and optional X/Twitter contact handle
preparation: Tool name, URL, 1-2 sentence description, tags, and pricing model
Appropriate category placement per the README structure
Optional Twitter/X handle for the 'Contact' field
workflow: Add the tool entry to the correct category section in README.md following the existing entry format
Open a pull request describing the addition
On merge, the tool appears on aitoollist.org under its category
watchFor: PR-based curation — acceptance depends on maintainer review; no SLA
Tiny directory (3 pages of listings, © 2025) — modest traffic expected
Follow the existing README format exactly or the PR likely stalls
Site is a static GitHub-pages-style mirror of the repo — the repo is the source of truth
countsAsLive: The tool's entry appears on aitoollist.org in its category after the PR merges
unknowns: Whether the site auto-deploys from the repo or is manually updated
Link type (dofollow/nofollow) on outbound tool links
